Variants.Content: The seasons in Westeros vary in length, with summer and winter lasting for many years, and the exact transition is difficult to predict. The Citadel is judged by the white crows passing the season, but the place still has to be prepared according to frost, migration, harvest and sea conditions; betting all the reserves on a warm year is often costly.
